'''Infamous Bounty Hunter's Armor''' was a type of [[Mandalorian armor/Legends|Mandalorian armor]]<ref name="Reveal" /> used around the time of the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|6.0}}</ref> When entering combat, the helmet reticle would lower and gauntlet would extend. The reticle color could also change based on color of a variety of equipped crystals.<ref name="Reveal" />

{{Tech-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Infamous_Bounty_Hunter_Armor.jpg|right|200px|thumb|Concept art by Anna Inkyung Lee.]]
The Infamous Bounty Hunter's Armor set debuted within the [[Cartel Market|''Star Wars: The Old Republic'' Cartel Market]], announced on [[October 20]], [[2020]], as part of a tie-in promotion for the [[Disney+]] television series [[Star Wars: The Mandalorian|''The Mandalorian'']]. The armor set could be bought alone or as a bundle with the [[Payday blaster pistol]] and the [[Amban JP blaster rifle]].<ref name="Reveal" /> The Infamous Bounty Hunter's Armor was designed by artist [[Anna Inkyung Lee]]<ref name="Anna">{{ArtStation|username=annainklee|url=artwork/xJwgaW|name=[[Anna Inkyung Lee]]|text=SWTOR the Infamous Bounty Hunter’s Armor Set}}</ref> and the 3D model was created by [[Adam Beardall]].<ref name="Adam">{{ArtStation|username=adambeardall|url=artwork/5XZJag|name=[[Adam Beardall]]|text=Infamous Bounty Hunter Armor Set}}</ref>
